name: rec_bench
description: rec_bench provides datasets and evaluation targets for offline recommendation experiments, measuring ranking and rating-prediction performance from user–item interaction data. It is intended for benchmarking recommender algorithms on top‑k retrieval and rating estimation tasks using industry-standard ranking metrics. The benchmark supports comparison of algorithms' ranking quality and retrieval effectiveness across one or more dataset splits.
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset; typical NDCG@10 often in the ~0.1–0.5 range
reputation: A small Hugging Face-hosted dataset used for experimental recommender evaluations; not as canonical as MovieLens but useful for prototyping.
